Egypt groundwater storage percentile

Weekly maps from NASA GRACE and GRACE-FO data assimilation, 2003 to 2026. Low values mean drier than usual, high values mean wetter than usual. Drag the slider or the graph to change the week.

Egypt average percentile

Source: GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D v3.0, NASA GSFC and GES DISC. Grid is 0.25 degrees, but GRACE itself resolves features of roughly 300 km, so small patterns are not real detail. Weeks missing from the record are skipped.
